column1: # Row 3 is why this file exists. On 2026-08-17 graphql-synthesizer ran this
# workflow, reported SUCCESS, bumped + tagged + pushed, and published nothing —
# because it was private and BOTH publish paths carry `&& !private`. That is the
# intended privacy posture (publishing from a private repo leaks code to
# crates.io and undoes yanks), and it is correct. What was missing is that
# nobody had written it down as an expectation, so a deliberate no-publish and a
# broken no-publish were the same green tick. Now it is asserted.
# always() is supplied per case because a rerun-after-failure is a different
# selection and the table should be able to say so.
# THE ONE THAT WAS SILENT. A private repo publishes by neither path, on purpose.
# The bot must not re-trigger itself; bump is skipped, and drip picks the run up
# through always() precisely because a needs-skipped job would otherwise skip it.
